conventions.convention: The domain is the three-dimensional periodic torus × an open time interval, evaluated as (x,t). Convolution uses volume measure, while normalized torus measure is L⁻³ dx; the kernel is nonnegative, smooth, compactly supported before periodization, and has unit mass.

The velocity-gradient entries are ∂ⱼuᵢ, D is its symmetric part, and A:B is the Frobenius contraction. Modeled stress is (2k/3)I₃ − 2νₜD, with prescribed k ≥ 0 and νₜ ≥ 0; forward transfer is minus the stress-gradient contraction.
The closure is an adopted model replacement, not an identification with exact covariance. Its dissipativity asserts neither empirical adequacy nor absence of exact-stress backscatter.
Countable Choice is explicitly assumed for the normalized periodic-torus supplier convention. Length, time, velocity, specific stress, and transfer use SI units.

load_bearing.statement: For the stated smooth periodic incompressible model, adopt τ_model = (2k/3)I₃ − 2νₜD with prescribed nonnegative C¹ fields k and νₜ, and define Π_model = −τ_model:∇ū. Substitute this modeled stress for exact covariance in the resolved momentum equation; equality with exact covariance and empirical adequacy are not asserted.

Under its stated periodic filtering, incompressibility, regularity, and adopted closure hypotheses, Π_model(x,t) = 2νₜ(x,t)|D(x,t)|²_F ≥ 0 and τ_model:∇ū = −2νₜ|D|²_F ≤ 0. With the additional ν > 0 and smooth-pressure hypotheses, replacing the exact stress slot in the resolved-energy balance contributes this nonpositive modeled term.

alerts.finding: The Definition writes the convolution as “∫ G_ℓ(r)q(x−r) dx”, although x is the free output variable and r is the integration variable. The following equality uses dμ_L(r), making the intended volume differential dr clear. This is a differential-variable typo.

The Statement and F1 write “q̄_ℓ(x)=∫ G_ℓ(r)q(x−r) dx”, and normalization is written “∫ G_ℓ(r) dx”. The summation/kernel variable is r; these volume differentials should bind r. The Euclidean representation and proof make the intended meaning recoverable.

The Statement and F1 define “q̄_ℓ(x)=∫ G_ℓ(r)q(x−r) dx”. Here x is the free evaluation variable, whereas r should be bound by the volume differential. The intended convolution is clear from the cited filter and subsequent proof.
